metaTitle: Custom Red Luggage ID Tags | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom red luggage ID tags in bulk from Perfect Imprints. Great for brand visibility and easy bag identification.
introHtml: Red luggage ID tags stand out on baggage carousels and overhead bins, making them a practical choice for frequent travelers and corporate gifts. The high-visibility color helps prevent bag mix-ups while offering a bold canvas for your logo. Choose from leather, plastic, or business card insert styles, all customizable with screen printing or debossing. Perfect for employee travel kits, client appreciation, or event giveaways where you want your brand to be noticed.
heroAltText: Custom red luggage ID tags with logo imprint, available in leather and plastic styles for bulk orders
